name: Main Gate
note: Primary entrance off East Colorado Ave. Bag check here.

name: East Gate
note: Opens at noon daily. Closest gate to the campground.

name: Box Office & Will Call
note: Opens 10:00 AM daily. Photo ID required for will call.

name: Info Booth
note: Lost and found, accessibility check-in, lost kids.

name: Brewers Showcase Tent
note: Tasting sessions Friday through Sunday afternoon.

name: Kids' Tent
note: Free with any ticket. Shade, crafts, and an instrument petting zoo.

name: Water Station — West
note: Free refills. Bring an empty bottle.

name: Medical Tent — Main Stage
note: Staffed whenever gates are open. Oxygen available.

name: Restrooms — Food Row
note: Accessible stalls at the east end of this bank.

name: Beer Garden
note: 21+ with wristband. ID check at the entrance.

name: Gondola — Station Telluride
note: Free. Runs to Mountain Village until midnight.

name: Town Park Shuttle Stop
note: Free Galloping Goose loop, roughly every 20 minutes.

name: Town Park Campground
note: Festival camping only. Quiet hours 1:00 AM to 7:00 AM.
